_doc: THE single source of AI price truth (Live-Values Doctrine, David 31 Jul 2026 — Addendum 7). No document, decision or tool may cite an AI price that is not on this card. Update = re-verify against the vendor's live page/console, bump verified_at, note the source. RG-0018 goes RED when this card is stale (>45 days) or misses a wired model. Prices are per MILLION tokens.

fx.note: Approximate rate; buffer applied on top when converting EUR lanes to USD (a USD rail cannot be a hard bound on unbuffered EUR spend — Peer cost review 31 Jul).
